summary: Closed the eligibility side of the witness work: the non-leader tick returns before the election check for observers and witnesses (citing thesis 4.2.1), becomeCandidate panics for both roles, and a separate guard ignores election requests while a membership change is committed but unapplied, so a node with a stale quorum view cannot win. Recorded one knowledge entry and an explained, refuted account, noting that witnesses still count toward the quorum that elects a leader and that vote-granting was not traced. No execution requested.
